profile.name: PVLogger日志文件夹管理器
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于读取、整理和解析PVLogger生成的日志文件夹。它可加载主配置与文件清单、读取各PV日志文本、并行解析未处理日志、识别新增日志文件，以及提取电机相关PV事件，常用于实验过程数据回顾、运行状态追踪和故障排查。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for reading, organizing, and parsing PVLogger log folders. It loads the main configuration and file list, reads PV log text, parses unprocessed logs in parallel, detects newly added log files, and extracts motor-related PV events. It is used for experiment data review, run-state tracking, and troubleshooting.
